about.title: About Amiristan Studio
paragraphs: Amiristan is an independent mobile application studio focused on crafting high-quality iOS and iPadOS experiences for global audiences. We believe software should be as creatively expressive as it is functionally powerful.

Our portfolio on the Apple App Store brings together two distinct creative pillars: Doodle Party, an interactive drawing and teaching canvas empowering educators, students, and teams; and AI Chatbot, a smart assistant accelerating research and daily correspondence. Together, they represent our dedication to elegance, performance, and user-first engineering.

faq.title: App Store & Licensing Questions
faq.subtitle: Details on Apple Pencil compatibility, App Store installation, volume classroom licensing, and data privacy

items.question: Which Apple devices are compatible with Doodle Party and AI Chatbot?
items.answer: Both apps run natively on iPadOS and iOS devices, with Doodle Party specifically optimized for iPad models supporting Apple Pencil (1st gen, 2nd gen, USB-C, and Apple Pencil Pro).

items.question: Can educational institutions purchase Doodle Party in bulk?
items.answer: Yes. Schools and universities can license Doodle Party through Apple School Manager and the Apple Volume Purchase Program (VPP) with educational discounts.

items.question: Can I record voice while drawing in Doodle Party?
items.answer: Yes. The built-in audio recorder synchronizes your voice narration with your canvas strokes, producing lightweight video lessons ready to export as MP4.

items.question: Does AI Chatbot require an active internet connection?
items.answer: AI Chatbot requires an active internet connection to communicate with advanced GPT inference servers, while your chat history is stored securely on your local device.

items.question: Can I export Doodle Party boards into PDF or image formats?
items.answer: Doodle Party supports one-tap export to vector PDF, high-resolution PNG, and MP4 video formats, enabling seamless sharing via AirDrop, Mail, or Google Drive.

items.question: Are updates and new drawing tools included with the app?
items.answer: All standard drawing tools, grid templates, and stability updates are included. Major cloud AI expansion packs receive regular improvements via the App Store.
